"{content}"

"{context}"

Has this stored memory become outdated, contradicted, or significantly changed based on the new context? Reply with exactly one of:
- UNCHANGED: if the memory is still accurate
- CHANGED: <updated version of the memory>

Be conservative: only mark CHANGED if there is a clear contradiction or significant update.
